basic_profile.name: Balfour Manuel
basic_profile.headline: Managing Director at Blue Dart
basic_profile.summary:
As Managing Director, I lead Blue Dart, South Asia's premier express air and integrated transportation & distribution company and part of Deutsche Post DHL Group’s DHL eCommerce Solutions division. 

Prior to my current role, I was Chief Executive Officer of the Company and also Senior Vice President in charge of Blue Dart’s B2B customers. 

I have also held a key senior management position at Blue Dart where I was responsible for the growth and development of the company’s business in the Western region in India.
 
I continue to drive the business with a clear strategic vision and focus on building a insanely customer centric culture at Blue Dart and sustaining our position as a Employer, Provider and Investment of Choice and fulfilling our Living Responsibility credo. 

I took over as Managing Director in 2019.

basic_profile.name: Beena Mathen Jacob
basic_profile.headline: Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO)| DHL Group - Blue Dart Express | People Strategy · HR Transformation · 50,000+ Workforce | Logistics & Supply Chain HR | IIM Calcutta | Business World HR 50 under 50
basic_profile.summary: Leading 50,000+ people is not HR—it’s business strategy in action.As the CHRO of Blue Dart Express (DHL Group), I lead people strategy for 50,000+ employees and associates across South Asia's most awarded express logistics enterprise. I drive HR strategy aligned to our vision of excellence in express logistics. My mandate spans talent strategy, organisational development, DEI, culture transformation, HR technology, and workforce planning — supporting a business that moves millions of shipments every day across India.In logistics, HR isn't a support function — it's an operational enabler.With 25 years spanning HR, Sales and Operations — including 16 years in logistics — I have led HR at scale across three of the world's most recognized supply chain and express logistics organisations:▸ Blue Dart Express (DHL Group) — CHRO, 50,000+ workforce▸ DHL Supply Chain India — VP HR & CHRO, 19,000 employees▸ FedEx TSCS — Senior HR leadershipThis cross-functional foundation — spanning HR, Sales and Operations — is rare at CHRO level. It enables me to bridge people strategy directly with operational reality, speaking the language of both the boardroom and the frontline.Core expertise: Chief HR Officer | People Strategy | HR Transformation | Talent Management | Organisational Development | DEI & Inclusion | Culture Change | HR Business Partner | Workforce Planning | HR Analytics | Employee Experience | Frontline Workforce | Learning & Development | Employer Branding | Psychological Safety | AI in HR | Future of WorkMBA — Pune University | EPSHRM — IIM Calcutta | B.Sc Mathematics — Mumbai University

past.employer_linkedin_description: The journey of securing lives began in 1994 for Zicom. With years of expertise and experience, Zicom etched a name for itself in the field of Electronic Security Surveillance in India. Over the last two decades, Zicom has expanded its reach to 5 countries, 1023 cities, and over a million happy customers, with an annual turnover of 926 crores.In less than two decades Zicom has established itself as a leader in the security domain, introducing distinct innovations that the rest of the industry has followed.Zicom has been the first Indian Electronic Security Systems company to:- Be listed on the Indian Bourses in 1995.- Pioneered the category of Electronic Security In India.- Introduce 24 x 7 Zicom Command Centre (ZCC) in 1995.- Introduce wireless security equipments in the home and retail segment.- Introduce Security Services called e-SaaS (Electronic Security as a Service).After years of experience and investment in state-of-the-art technology, we have developed a range of premier products designed with the precision of quality and reliability. Our solutions that use cloud technology include CCTV Surveillance System, Access Control System, Fire Alarm System, Multi-Apartment Video Door Phones, Video Door Phones, Intruder Alarm System, Fingerprint Locks, and Remote Managed Services (RAM) . Over time, we have gathered not only the trust of our customers but also their love for unparalleled services and superior quality..

basic_profile.name: Savio Mendonca
basic_profile.headline: Vice President- Internal Audit & Risk Management at Blue Dart Group
basic_profile.current_title: Vice President- Internal Audit & Risk Management
basic_profile.summary: Savio is a highly accomplished and experienced leader in the fields of Internal Audit and Finance. With a career spanning over three decades, Savio has gained extensive expertise across various sectors, including IT, Manufacturing, and Logistics. He has successfully led and managed the internal audit function for large listed corporations with complex global operations, demonstrating his ability to navigate and excel in challenging business environments.Savio's professional qualifications speak volumes about his commitment to continuous learning and professional growth. As a Chartered Accountant, Certified Information Systems Auditor, Certified Fraud Examiner and Certified Logistics Leader (CLL - DHL), Savio has acquired specialized knowledge and skills in accounting, information systems, fraud detection, finance management, and logistics. Currently serving as the Vice President of Internal Audit & Risk management at Blue Dart, Savio holds a key leadership role within the organization. In his prior positions, he held the position of Director at Capgemini, where he played an integral role in the Group Internal Audit. At IGATE Corporation, Savio served as the Head of Internal Audit - Corporate Risk Management, demonstrating his ability to identify and mitigate risks at an organizational level. He also served as the Head of Revenue Assurance at Patni Computers, where he showcased his expertise in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of revenue-related processes. Additionally, Savio contributed significantly to the Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) initiative and Costing Function at Mahindra & Mahindra Limited, further enhancing his proficiency in process optimization and financial analysis.Recognized as a subject matter expert, Savio frequently shares his knowledge and insights as a speaker at prominent professional forums such as the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) and the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) Mumbai Chapter. His contributions to these platforms demonstrate his commitment to fostering professional development and knowledge-sharing within the industry.Savio's exceptional leadership and people management skills have earned him accolades and recognition. In 2021, he was ranked among India's Top 100 Great People Managers by the Great Manager Institute in association with Forbes India. This prestigious honor reflects Savio's ability to inspire and motivate his team members, creating a positive work environment that drives individual and collective success.

Today, we are a Powerhouse of successful Brands : We believe in shaping market trends with a portfolio of innovative brands. Our flagship brand, The Times of India, is the world’s largest circulating English daily & The Economic Times is the world’s second largest circulating English Business daily. We are driven by the indomitable spirit to question the conventional wisdom. Learning & Innovative : We are regarded as one of the most innovative publishing companies. Our unique 'Brand Capital model' is considered amongst the most innovative ideas. Previous innovations include Invitation Pricing, Combos, Space Drawing Rights & Advertorial Supplements. We provide our employees opportunities through world-class training programs. Great People : ‘Finest minds who inspire & drive innovative initiatives, build trust & encourage employees to achieve optimal performance’ is the Hallmark of our leadership team. We are one internally cohesive & disciplined team of people from diverse backgrounds. We invest in our people & our policies are designed for their long-term happiness. If you are curious & look for avenues of continuous improvement, this is the place to be!

basic_profile.name: Sandeep Petkar
basic_profile.headline: Vice President Regional Head - South, Bangalore |  Blue Dart, India | Profit Centre Head | F1 freak
basic_profile.current_title: Vice President Regional Head - South Region
basic_profile.summary:
An energetic leader with a passion to deliver results at all times with a vast experience and knowledge about express business. 

I started my career with Blue Dart in 1991 in its  IT function and continued to excel for  next twenty years before switching over to Sales Function in 2010. Held a position of Sales Head for next seven years at West2 region which is headquartered at Ahmedabad. It was 2017 when I was elevated to the position of Regional Head at West2 Region. On 1st September 2024, I moved to Bangalore to act as an Regional Head for Southern Region.

I am thoroughly enjoying  my current role as it allows me to connect with close to 3800 die-hard Blue Darters and lead them in offering their world class service to Blue Dart's esteemed customers.

To sum it up, I would like to state that it has been a wonderful and fun-filled journey of three decades which offered me huge opportunities to sharpen my skills, build a strong character and career and interact with huge number of internal and external customers, laced with numerous achievements and lots of learning.

basic_profile.name: Srividya Harish Venkateswaran
basic_profile.headline: HR Leader - Always thirsty for excellence, open to new ideas, and continuously learning—driven by a passion for well-being, human rights, and fostering growth with a side of humor!
basic_profile.current_title: Senior Director - Business HR and Talent Acquisition
basic_profile.summary:
At the forefront of Blue Dart's HR and talent acquisition, my expertise lies in aligning human resources operations with comprehensive global and regional strategies. The role involves strategic manpower planning, enhancing employee engagement, and fostering a robust culture of growth and continuous improvement. Our team's collaborative efforts with industry bodies and government authorities underscore our commitment to progressive talent development and succession planning.

With over 23 years of experience in leadership roles across HR, Service Delivery, and Business Operations, I have successfully led teams and driven strategic growth initiatives in major global organizations. Currently, as Senior Director - Business HR & Talent Acquisition at Blue Dart Express, I spearhead HR operations, talent acquisition strategies, and workforce planning, aligning them with organizational goals to ensure seamless business performance.

Throughout my career, I have held key roles in program management, service delivery, compliance, and risk management at organizations like DHL Global Forwarding, DXC Technology, HCL Technologies, IBM, and Thomson Reuters. I specialize in creating solutions that foster organizational growth, operational efficiency, and a positive workplace culture. My expertise spans governance, program delivery, financial advisory, regulatory compliance, employee engagement, and performance management.

At my core, I operate as a logistics ecosystem orchestrator, ensuring transportation networks, warehousing platforms, aviation cargo operations, and enterprise supply chain programs function as one integrated commercial system capable of delivering performance at scale.

The Indian Army is the largest branch of the Indian Armed Forces and is responsible for land-based military operations. Its primary mission is the National Security and Defense of India from external aggression and threats, and maintaining peace and security within its borders. It also conducts humanitarian rescue operations during natural calamities and other disturbances. The Indian Army is one of the three services under the Ministry of Defence.The President of India is the Commander-in-Chief of the Indian Armed Forces, and thus of the Indian Army. The highest ranking military officer is the Chief of Army Staff (COAS), who is also a member of the Chiefs of Staff Committee.The Indian Army came into being at the Independence of India in 1947, and inherited most of the regiments and infrastructure of the British Indian Army that were located in post-partition India.
